task_reconstruction.official_task: 2022 MCM Problem C, as restated on physical page 3.
required_outputs: a model and a trading strategy built only on prices known up to the trading day
the value of an initial 1000 dollars after five years
evidence that the strategy is the best one
the sensitivity of the strategy and of the final value to transaction costs

contributions.summary: Seven stock indicators, refit on the first year, give a usable buy rule and sell rule for both assets.
A vote of five factors, firing at three or more, plus a next-day forecast and a forced stop, beats the untuned strategy.
The strategy is the best available one, even though an omniscient investor would do far better.
Raising the transaction cost trims the result but does not break the strategy.

dependency_graph.handoff: the factor signal and its free parameters, which the search tunes
the tuned buy and sell flags
the position ratio used when both assets fire
the next-day price that replaces today's factor input
the forced sale that overrides a hold

assumptions.summary: Bitcoin has no minimum trading unit.
Gold futures have no minimum trading unit.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Both series run 1826 days, from 11 September 2016 to 10 September 2021.
Missing gold prices are filled with the previous day's price.
The factors are taken from the Wind database and the MindGo library and use only closing prices.

models.summary: Seven stock indicators are borrowed and sorted into three families. Each one is glossed as a symbol, a plain name, a job, and its free parameters, and then turned into a buy rule and a sell rule. KDJ is named in the overbought family but no formula is printed for it.

One factor at a time is turned into a small planning model. Cash, holdings and the two flags move day by day, the flags fire off the factor, and the objective is the most terminal assets. The gold copy repeats the bitcoin program. For MACD only the trigger test is swapped.

Daily returns feed a variance and a covariance, and the position in each asset is chosen to make the portfolio variance as small as it can be. The objective is printed as the square root of its own square, and the covariance term is indexed one letter off.
Five factors vote for each asset. A trade fires when three or more of them agree. When both assets fire, the mean-variance weights set the split. The whole rule is prose: no formula is displayed.

A three-gate recurrence reads today's factors and yesterday's prediction and emits the next price. The activation is printed as the two words tan y, and the forget term carries no subscript. The predicted price then stands in for the last close inside three of the factor formulas.

A mandatory sale is added and said to fire when the decline reaches a fifth. The printed test subtracts the wrong day's price for bitcoin and subtracts a gold price from itself, so the gold test can never fire.

An investor who already knows the next five years of prices is given a planning program over both assets. It is solved and the result is used as a ceiling the strategy reaches only a sliver of. The last constraint bounds the gold flags by the gold price.

verification.summary: The factors are defended by common use and by theoretical proof.
An omniscient investor's ceiling is computed and the model reaches 0.0013 percent of it.
The yearly returns are set beside two named firms.
The strategy is recomputed while each commission runs from nothing to a high rate.

results_trace.summary: One thousand dollars becomes 125716.87 dollars, then 190635.58 after the improvement.
The new program is said to reach 190635.58 dollars.
Table 4 prints 189635.58 dollars for the new program and 124716.87 for the original.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge checking the required proof finds an unreachable ceiling and a comparison with two firms, with the bias conceded before the win is claimed.

weaknesses.summary: The index-weighted average is built from C_t.
TRMA is a function of n_1 and averages TRIX over n_2 days.
The band width is the root of a sum of (w_i MA_i) times the departure.
The cash update adds the proceeds of a sale and subtracts the cost of a purchase.
The flags fire off the modified RSI.
The MACD model only has to change the buy-sell test in equation (7).
The portfolio variance uses the covariance at the same day as the weights.
The gates use a hyperbolic tangent.
A sale is forced when gold has fallen by a fifth.
The gold flags obey the same bounds as the bitcoin flags.
The tuned RSI earns $36,867 more than the untuned one.
The best gold period is n=1.
Gold votes with BOLL and bitcoin votes with WR.
The trade count falls as the transaction cost rises.
The KDJ gold strategy earned 0.48 percent a year.
The improved strategy finished 51.64 percent ahead.

unresolved_questions: Equation (8) and equation (10) reverse the buy and sell flags.
Equation (24) compares the gold price with itself, so the stop never fires.
Figure 4 prints a margin of 36867 dollars that none of its callouts support.
Page 18 prints 190635.58 dollars and Table 4 prints 189635.58.
The summary says six factors while both voting sets hold five.
